boundary_principles.heading: trivial task 可以轻量处理，但不能越界

architecture: Minimal machine state layer：只记录 hash、revision、status、diagnostics、transaction pointer。
Runtime evidence layer：只在 implement / QA / release 运行时写入过程、线程、session、trace、evidence JSON。
decision_priority: Markdown truth 高于 machine cache。
Deterministic parser 高于 LLM interpretation。
Minimal state cache 高于 fulltext mirror。
Runtime JSON 只属于 implement / QA / release 过程证据。
缺失或漂移时 fail closed，而不是从旧 JSON 猜测 truth。

tasks.title: FR-001 Beacon 必须把 Markdown 作为需求冻结唯一 truth
tasks.description: 冻结阶段 gate 不得以 fulltext machine mirror 作为 truth source。

tasks.title: FR-002 Beacon 必须提供 Markdown strict parser contract
tasks.description: PRD、user-story、test-case 必须保持可被 deterministic parser 读取的结构。

tasks.title: FR-003 Beacon 必须将冻结阶段 JSON 收缩为最小状态缓存
tasks.description: 冻结阶段 JSON 不得复制 Markdown 全文，只能存储 hash、revision、status、diagnostics、transaction pointer。

tasks.title: FR-004 Beacon 必须禁止 fulltext machine mirrors
tasks.description: PRD canonical JSON、requirement envelope、candidate ledger、QA matrix 等冻结阶段机器材料不得包含完整 Markdown 正文副本。

tasks.title: FR-005 Beacon 必须保留 runtime evidence JSON
tasks.description: implement / QA / release 的进程、线程、session、trace、evidence、test result 仍使用 JSON。

tasks.title: FR-006 Beacon 必须让 gate 从 Markdown 解析 truth
tasks.description: Material audit、requirement clarity、refreeze、implement preflight 必须以 Markdown truth 为第一读取源。

tasks.title: FR-007 Beacon 必须用 hash 检测 Markdown truth drift
tasks.description: 当 Markdown truth 改变但冻结 state 未刷新时，gate 必须阻断并回 `beacon-change`。

tasks.title: FR-008 Beacon 必须提供 no silent cache fallback
tasks.description: 当 Markdown 解析失败、cache 缺失、hash mismatch 或 refreeze status 不明时，gate 必须 fail closed。 ## 6. 冻结交付物 `docs/beacon/v1.4.8/research/markdown-first-freeze-truth-and-minimal-machine-state-contract.md` `docs/beacon/v1.4.8/source-architecture/markdown-first-freeze-truth-and-minimal-machine-state-contract.md` `docs/beacon/v1.4.8/change/markdown-first-freeze-truth-and-minimal-machine-state-contract.md` `docs/beacon/v1.4.8/prd/markdown-first-freeze-truth-and-minimal-machine-state-contract.md` `docs/beacon/v1.4.8/user-story/markdown-first-freeze-truth-and-minimal-machine-state-contract.md` `docs/beacon/v1.4.8/qa/test-cases/markdown-first-freeze-truth-and-minimal-machine-state-contract.md` `docs/beacon/v1.4.8/release/checklist-v1.4.8-markdown-first-freeze-truth.md` ## 7. 风险与缓解 | 风险 | 影响 | 缓解 | | --- | --- | --- | | Markdown 格式不严格 | gate 解析不稳定 | 冻结 strict parser contract 并 fail closed | | 移除 fulltext mirror 后调试困难 | gate 输出信息变少 | diagnostics 保留 path、line、hash、reason_code | | runtime JSON 被误删 | implement / QA / release evidence 丢失 | 明确 runtime JSON 保留 | | cache 缺失被误认为不需要 | 静默放行 | missing cache / parse failure 必须阻断 | | 旧版本大 JSON 兼容问题 | 历史材料读取不一致 | 新合同只约束 v1.4.8+ 新生成材料 | ## 8. 验收标准 AC-001 Beacon treats Markdown PRD, user-story, test-case, research, execution, and release documents as the canonical freeze truth. AC-002 Beacon does not treat frozen-stage fulltext machine mirrors as canonical truth. AC-003 Beacon stores only minimal freeze state in requirement-stage JSON. AC-004 Beacon keeps implement, QA, release runtime evidence JSON. AC-005 Beacon parses AC and test-case coverage from Markdown truth before consulting cache. AC-006 Beacon blocks when Markdown parser fails. AC-007 Beacon blocks when Markdown baseline hash differs from frozen state. AC-008 Beacon blocks when refreeze transaction status is missing or ambiguous. AC-009 Beacon emits diagnostics with path, line or section, hash, reason_code, and repair route. AC-010 Beacon provides a migration boundary so historical fulltext JSON remains readable but new v1.4.8+ freeze artifacts stop duplicating full Markdown. ## 9. 成功指标 新冻结材料的 machine JSON 体积明显下降。 Gate 仍能 fail closed。 人类审查只需要读 Markdown truth。 Runtime evidence 仍能支持 implement / QA / release。
